questions.q: What is the capital of Eritrea?
questions.why: Its modernist buildings are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: From which country did Eritrea gain independence in 1993?
questions.why: It fought a 30-year war.

questions.q: Which European country colonised Eritrea in 1890?
questions.why: Many Italian buildings remain.

questions.q: Who has been President of Eritrea since 1993?
questions.why: No national election has been held.

questions.q: What is Eritrea's currency?
questions.why: It is named after a town in the war.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Eritrea's coast?
questions.why: It has a long coastline.

questions.q: Which 1998–2000 war was fought with Ethiopia?
questions.why: Peace came only in 2018.

questions.q: Which town was the resistance's base during the independence war?
questions.why: Its name was given to the currency.

questions.q: Which country ruled Eritrea from 1941 to 1952?
questions.why: It then joined Ethiopia in a federation.

questions.q: Which Ethiopian leader made a peace deal with Eritrea in 2018?
questions.why: He won the Nobel Peace Prize.

questions.q: Which front led Eritrea to independence?
questions.why: It is now the ruling party.

questions.q: Which ancient kingdom ruled parts of Eritrea from Aksum?
questions.why: It was a great trading power.

questions.q: Which port city was badly damaged in the war and is famous for coral buildings?
questions.why: It was called the 'Pearl of the Red Sea'.

questions.q: Which national service is compulsory and often indefinite?
questions.why: It has led many to flee.

questions.q: In which year did Eritreans vote for independence?
questions.why: Over 99% voted yes.

questions.q: Which famous modernist service station in Asmara looks like an aeroplane?
questions.why: It was built in 1938.

questions.q: Which train line climbs from Massawa to Asmara?
questions.why: It has steam engines.

questions.q: Which flatbread made from teff is eaten with stews?
questions.why: It is spongy and sour.

questions.q: Which island group is a famous diving area?
questions.why: It has around 200 islands.

questions.q: Which coffee ceremony is a common tradition?
questions.a: Roasting and serving coffee in three rounds
questions.why: It is a sign of friendship.

questions.q: Which language is the most widely spoken in Eritrea?
questions.why: Tigre is also widely spoken.

questions.q: Which desert lowland is one of the hottest places on Earth?
questions.why: It stretches into Ethiopia.

questions.q: Which spicy stew is Eritrea's national dish?
questions.why: It is made with berbere spice.

questions.q: Which ancient town has a rock-cut cistern and stone ruins?
questions.why: It dates from Aksumite times.

questions.q: Which ancient port city traded with Rome?
questions.why: It was the port of Aksum.

questions.q: Which sport is the most popular in Eritrea?
questions.why: Italians brought it.

questions.q: Which Eritrean cyclist wore the Tour de France polka-dot jersey in 2015?
questions.why: He wore it for four days.

questions.q: Which Eritrean cyclist was the first Black African to win a Tour de France stage?
questions.why: He won the green jersey in 2024.

questions.q: Which Eritrean runner won Olympic 10,000 m bronze in 2004?
questions.why: It was Eritrea's first Olympic medal.

questions.q: Which town in the highlands has a Commonwealth war cemetery?
questions.why: A big battle was fought there in 1941.
